summary: Centralize navigation documentation and contracts with thin vault adapters
description: Move shared navigation specification and executable navigation contract ownership upstream. Replace conflicting local active instructions with compatible adapters in both vaults; preserve legacy writer scopes, anchors and source/task identities. Release, update and run strict checks.
acceptance: Public documentation describes the single numbered profile, tile navigation, component Wiki/Raw and Event Note v1.1 without private data.
Shared navigation contracts and checked adapter boundaries have one maintained upstream owner; local provider and legacy exceptions remain explicit.
Both vaults receive compatible thin local documentation preserving existing links/anchors and no new active conflicting generic rules.
Independent review, local tests, release/install integrity and before/after strict layout checks verified; findings honestly reported.
